name: safety-governance
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when trust-ladder / budget enforcement moves into a different layer than a project-local central config (config.json) consulted at tick entry, or when the config schema reaches its next breaking major (3.0.0).
spec_change_reason: Add the additive implement_test_command config key (schema 2.7.0 -> 2.8.0) making the IMPLEMENT-side per-work-order test-gate configurable. safety_governance.py bumps GOVERNANCE_SCHEMA_VERSION to 2.8.0, adds implement_test_command=None to DEFAULT_GOVERNANCE, surfaces it RAW through _overlay (explicit value incl. null/'none'/'skip' honored, absent backfills None), and adds the pure accessor implement_test_command(config) returning the raw value WITHOUT interpreting it (mirrors regression_command); the three-way interpretation (null = run <feature>/test/run.py; a command string = run it; the sentinel 'none'/'skip' = skip the gate) lives in implement's test_gate.py (separate downstream cycle). configure.py adds --implement-test-command via _parse_implement_test_command ('' clears to null, 'none'/'skip' PRESERVED VERBATIM as the skip sentinel because null and 'none' mean different things, else trimmed), extends configure()/argparse/mutating-detection, and adds a _field_catalog entry under the IMPLEMENT stage right after mode. The configure SKILL.md is left unchanged (the --setup walk-through is catalog-driven via --describe). spec.md already carried the surface (committed 3d65008); this cycle implements code+tests and raises the housekeep doc-baseline floor 411->438 for the legitimate spec growth.
spec_no_change_reason: spec.md schema_version field-merge-exclusion paragraph was authored+committed in this cycle's spec-update step (dfc9e37); no further uncommitted spec diff
